stats.notes: Baseline from IPEDS (fall 2023 entering class, ADM2023). UW-Stout's 2025-26 Common Data Set is linked from uwstout.edu but sits behind a Microsoft SharePoint sign-in and could not be read as text, so CDS figures (international applicants/admits, GPA, SAT/ACT) are not added. IPEDS reports ACT scores only (no SAT) and no residency split. College Navigator also shows fall 2024: 5,547 applicants, 88% admitted, 24% of admits enrolled; about 5% of undergraduates are U.S. nonresidents (fall 2024).

cost.notes: UW-Stout international undergraduate estimate for 2026-27 (30 credits): tuition and fees $21,785; housing $5,340 plus food and living expenses $3,792 (room_board_usd = $9,132); mandatory health insurance $2,010 (other_usd); total $32,927. The page expects about 8 percent yearly increases. ESL Institute students: tuition and fees $12,299, total $23,441. Domestic in-state and out-of-state tuition not recorded.
